title: Callimachus at Marathon
summary: Raleigh names Callimachus at Marathon in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Callimachus, one of the Graecians of marke who fell in the first encounter at Marathon. He is not Callimachus, who in his Hymnes witnesseth the tombe in Mountaine Iasius. The one-word title would haue linked that poet, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
